name: Survey tile in Sextans
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sextans, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 9 visits over 63 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2025-11-27, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
